#gallery — 801×801 windowless gallery (examples/gallery_frame)

Same path as examples/gallery_frame.rs: Program::parse of docs/gallery/*.bb → World::new_with_origin → Camera::from_anchor (yaw 35°, pitch −22°, margin 1.28) → Renderer. No window, no crosshair. Load runs symbol at 81×81 (same function, bounded viewport). Buttons run the real 801×801 raster (RGBA 2,566,404 bytes). Program ids: 0 symbol, 1 recognition, 2 architecture, 3 recursion. The example-default recursion button stays at 35°/−22°. recursion dead-frontal is the documented axis pose: yaw 0°, pitch 0° (docs/GALLERY.md “dead-frontal” / central axis; generate.py aligns the camera with the tunnel axis; neither source gives a numeric yaw).

#sidebar — 1201×801 windowless composite

Not run on load. Renderer of the origin world at 801×801 (Camera::for_single_pixel_voxel) then FrameCompositor::compose at 1201×801 (sidebar 400). No winit, softbuffer, or windows-sys. match_known is the host string from that call: frame tag, non-background count, and RGBA byte length (1201×801×4 = 3848004).

#play — browser stand-in for the native window

Live game canvas. Resolution is the internal render size; the canvas is CSS-upscaled to the page width. Default High 1600×900 + 400 sidebar. Native 801+400 is the native window / tape layout. Game only hides the sidebar so the game view fills the width (browser-only layout). Same AcceptedAction / fixed-tick path as native App. The live loop runs every due 60 Hz tick but finalises at most one frame per requestAnimationFrame, and only when something changed. Live frames skip the per-frame SHA-256 audit; frame=pending is hashed once the view is idle for 250 ms. play tape resets to the native 801+400 layout and runs the fully audited per-tick path. Keys: WASD move, Space up, Shift down, F fit, F3 sidebar metrics, Esc release capture. Movement is level-latched (native): hold across a tick to move. Click the game view to capture (pointer lock); captured LMB deletes, RMB places; mouse looks; wheel dollies.

#storage — IndexedDB carriers (journal / history / display)

Pure StorageChain bytes verified with inspect_bytes / typed replay — the same admission filesystem open uses after reading the file. Exclusive Journal file custody is Windows-only; here JS holds the carrier in IndexedDB DB bitblock. A successful readwrite transaction oncomplete (Chrome durability:'strict' when supported) is the durability analogue of File::sync_all returning Ok (not power-loss proof). One shared IDB connection; ops are serialized. Status shows idb=committed only after oncomplete. Write stores bytes; Verify loads from IndexedDB and re-checks in wasm; Clear drops the object store entry. Verify must still match after a real page reload.
